component.name: SteamSNM
component.summary: Desktop monitor for Steam prices, discounts, and player counts

description.p: SteamSNM is an independent desktop client for tracking Steam games: prices, discounts, current player counts, new releases, price history, and notifications.
Data comes from the official public Steam Store API and Steam Web API. The application does not use or scrape SteamDB.
First release: price, discount, player count, and new release monitoring.
